LT_BASIC.Description: As basic as a lantern gets: it lights up and the radio works.

LT_BEGINNER.DescriptionHold: Grants a 300 hit point shield that lasts 15 seconds.
LT_BEGINNER.Description: A useful tool for Ramsgate's Recruits

LT_FULGAR.DescriptionHold: Fires a lightning bolt in a direction that deals 400 Shock damage multiple times as it passes through enemies.

LT_LERAWR.DescriptionHold: Create a fire ball in front of you that explodes after 4 seconds, dealing 3250 Blaze damage to nearby enemies.
LT_LERAWR.Description: Attack faster with this fiery lantern.

LT_MCROLLIN.DescriptionHold: Create a frost pillar in front of you that deals 2500 Frost damage to nearby enemies over 10 seconds.
LT_MCROLLIN.Description: Helps boost a Slayer's stamina thanks to powerful aetheric ambience.

LT_MOONFACE.DescriptionHold: Creates an aura that grants nearby Slayers 15% increased move speed and attack speed for 10 seconds.
LT_MOONFACE.Description: Move as swiftly as the ferocious Shrike.

LT_PAPER.DescriptionHold: Dash in a direction, deal 2250 Terra damage to nearby enemies upon arrival, and gain 15% lifesteal for 10 seconds.

LT_ROCK.Description: A lantern that protects you in combat.

LT_TRIALS_00.DescriptionHold: Drop a bomb from above that explodes after 1 second. Deals 2750 damage and can interrupt Behemoths.
LT_TRIALS_00.Description: Strike with the full fury of the Fortunate Soul.
